# JCEF Maven

The experimental Linux player uses [jcefmaven](https://github.com/jcefmaven/jcefmaven),
an independent Maven distribution of the Java Chromium Embedded Framework.

- Project: `me.friwi:jcefmaven`
- License: Apache License 2.0
- Upstream JCEF/CEF components remain subject to their respective licenses.

The Linux package downloads the matching native JCEF bundle into the current
user's Hoshira cache on the first player launch.
